notes.title: Tales of Eldoria Joins RPG Maker Festival 2025!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45196076/94b5e08ff23d103032baa85e065be16f655e4374.png[/img]

Hey everyone!

I’m excited to announce that [b]Tales of Eldoria[/b] is participating in [b]RPG Maker Festival 2025[/b] on Steam! 🎉 This is a huge moment for us, and being part of this celebration alongside so many talented indie devs makes it even more special.

The RPG Maker community has been an incredible source of inspiration and support throughout development, and I want to take a moment to thank every single one of you—whether you want to play the game, shared it with friends, or simply followed along this journey. Your encouragement means the world!

To mark the occasion, we’re sharing our [b]latest game trailer[/b], so be sure to check it out! If you haven’t already, [b]wishlist the game[/b] to stay updated on everything coming next.

[previewyoutube=SMxuu4GqA4w;full][/previewyoutube]

Thank you all for being part of this adventure!

notes.title: Turn-Based RPG Fest X New Trailer
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45196076/1ff9d408eb077cf6810ea984d991a3069337d7de.png[/img]

Hey everyone!

I'm beyond excited to share that our game is participating in its very first Steam event — [b]Turn-Based RPG Fest[/b]! It's a huge milestone for us, and we couldn’t have timed it better with a brand-new trailer, showcasing some of the gameplay and key features we've been working hard on.

[previewyoutube=d85Mcf9gVHA;full][/previewyoutube]

The journey so far has been incredible, and I want to take a moment to appreciate everyone who's supported and helped shape this game through development. Your feedback and encouragement mean the world to me!

Check out the new trailer, share your thoughts, and if you haven’t already, don’t forget to [b]wishlist the game to stay updated[/b]!

Thank you all for being part of this adventure!
